For an on-demand booking the rider-side branch is NS-4: cancellation within 3 minutes of matching is free, later is chargeable [F2]. The rider cancelled at 17:15:05, 185 s (3 min 5 s) after acceptance at 17:12:00 [F2], so the fee condition in NS-4 is met and no refund follows. The rider's ground that the driver was "still far away" is not a ground in the policy: the driver's closest approach was 1725 m and the platform never recorded arrival [F1][F3], but NS-4 expressly makes non-arrival irrelevant, since Ryde publishes no free-cancel-on-late-ETA rule and the rider's remedy is a human appeal under NS-7. events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your no-show dispute is closed and the $6.61 cancellation fee stands — no refund is due.

Here's why: you cancelled the ride 3 minutes and 5 seconds after a driver accepted it. Cancelling more than 3 minutes after matching is chargeable, and that rule applies to on-demand rides. How far away the driver still was doesn't change the outcome, since there's no free-cancel rule for a late arrival estimate.

Nothing changes on your account — no flag, no amount owed beyond the fee already charged. If you believe this was wrong, you can ask for a human to review it.

DRIVER: The rider's dispute over this cancellation is closed in your favour, and no refund was given.

What decided it: the rider cancelled 3 minutes and 5 seconds after you accepted the trip. Cancelling more than 3 minutes after matching is chargeable, and that applies to on-demand rides. Because we never recorded you as arrived, the arrival-based fee rules never came into it — no harm there either way.

The $6.61 cancellation fee is yours as usual, paid to your Ryde account as a Ryde voucher. Nothing negative goes on your account, and no action is needed from you.
